CREATE TABLE "public"."project_budget" (
  "billableOnly" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "budgetMinutes" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currency" text DEFAULT 'USD' NOT NULL,
  "hourlyRateCents" int4,
  "kind" text DEFAULT 'one_off' NOT NULL,
  "projectId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "warningPercent" int4 DEFAULT 80 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("projectId"),
  CONSTRAINT "project_budget_kind_check_de785e65" CHECK ("kind" IN ('one_off', 'retainer')),
  CONSTRAINT "project_budget_minutes_positive_81247551" CHECK ("budgetMinutes" > 0),
  CONSTRAINT "project_budget_rate_non_negative_b6a6c68b" CHECK ("hourlyRateCents" IS NULL OR "hourlyRateCents" >= 0),
  CONSTRAINT "project_budget_warning_percent_087517d6" CHECK ("warningPercent" BETWEEN 1 AND 100)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."project_budget_alert" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "level" text NOT NULL,
  "periodKey" text NOT NULL,
  "projectId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("projectId", "periodKey", "level"),
  CONSTRAINT "project_budget_alert_level_check_57e39686" CHECK ("level" IN ('warning', 'overrun'))
)
